baseline_models.focus_anchor: وجوه at word 1 is the observer-facing surface, while ناعمة at word 3 carries softness and easeful living.
baseline_models.mechanism: The predicate transfers both tactile softness and an unstrained mode of life onto the visible front, making condition legible as countenance.

activation_trace.role: The bodily face and outward front provide the visible surface on which the state appears.
Softness and easeful living supply a state that is simultaneously material, bodily, and experiential.

changed_reading.after: The faces visibly carry softened, unstrained ease; bodily appearance and lived condition coincide.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The face at word 1 can stand for the person, and ناعمة at word 3 can denote bounty and good condition.
baseline_models.mechanism: Face-for-self expands the adjective beyond skin or expression: the whole person is presented through the part that meets others, while bounty names the person's encompassing condition.

activation_trace.role: Face as self makes the visible countenance a compact reference to the whole person.
Bounty and good condition extend the predicate from appearance to the person's total flourishing.

changed_reading.before: The adjective describes facial texture or expression alone.
changed_reading.after: Whole persons, shown through their faces, stand in a condition of received bounty and flourishing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وجوه at word 1 can be directions or proper courses, while the root of ناعمة at word 3 can perform praise.
baseline_models.mechanism: The clause can carry a directional layer in which the subjects' facings are not only comfortable but commendable and sound.

activation_trace.role: Orientation and destination turn the plural faces into plural ways of facing or proceeding.
The proper aspect or sound course gives the orientation a normative rather than merely spatial value.
The praise branch supplies approval, allowing the predicate to commend how these faces are directed.

changed_reading.after: Their very facing or course is excellent and rightly ordered, with comfort as one consequence of that orientation.

context_deltas.mechanism: An event that covers all is rendered locally readable on exposed fronts: the repeated face-clause divides the covered field into visibly opposed conditions.

activation_trace.role: The outward face is the observer-facing display surface for the focus condition.
Soft ease supplies the positive condition displayed on that surface.
The branch of a covering that encompasses everything supplies the common field within which outcomes become visible.
The repeated outward face establishes the same diagnostic surface on the contrasting side.
Lowering and submission provide the negative visible posture against which focus ease is differentiated.

structural_cues: 88:2 and 88:8 repeat the frame وجوه يومئذ with opposed feminine-singular predicates.
The negative face panel is expanded before the focus clause opens the positive panel.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an all-enveloping event and two identically framed face states; I infer that the event writes differentiated outcomes onto visible fronts. A live alternative is that the pair only classifies two groups without making faces a causal display mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus independently reports pleasant faces.
changed_reading.after: These faces are the exposed readout of how an all-covering event has met particular persons, sharply reversing the lowered faces of the paired panel.

context_deltas.mechanism: The negative panel depicts expenditure without return: labor becomes exhaustion and intake neither builds the body nor answers hunger. Against that failed economy, ناعمة names successful sufficiency and release from attritional need.

activation_trace.role: Good condition and bounty supply the positive outcome absent from the failed economy.
Easeful living supplies relief from strain rather than a merely decorative softness.
Purposive work supplies the expenditure side of the negative mechanism.
Exhausting toil makes the work bodily depleting rather than fruitful.
Bodily fattening, explicitly negated in the source clause, supplies the missing nutritive result.
Sufficiency, also negated, identifies the deeper failure of the available intake.
The empty belly supplies the unmet need that remains after eating.

structural_cues: 88:3-7 continue the predicates and consequences of the faces in 88:2.
88:8 restarts the exact plural-face and day-deictic frame after the sequence of work, intake, and failed sufficiency.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies labor, exhaustion, failed bodily gain, failed sufficiency, and hunger; I infer an input-output system whose breakdown marks the first faces and whose reversal marks the focus faces. Alternatively, ناعمة may contrast only affectively with misery, without implying restored material sufficiency.

changed_reading.before: ناعمة means a generally luxurious or soft appearance.
changed_reading.after: The softness is relief from futile expenditure: these faces register a condition in which effort and provision no longer consume the person without answering need.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequel prevents ease from collapsing into idleness: purposeful movement and earning are retrospectively accepted, and that settled relation to one's striving is what the face displays.

activation_trace.role: Face-for-person lets the satisfaction concern the whole agent rather than an isolated expression.
Good condition supplies the settled outcome of the agent's relation to prior striving.
Work, earning, and conduct supply the purposeful history behind the present condition.
Satisfaction opposed to displeasure supplies settled approval of that history.
The second mapped acceptance branch preserves the split root while reinforcing willing reception rather than resentment.

structural_cues: 88:9 follows the focus without introducing a new nominal subject, naturally continuing the focus faces.
The prepositional attachment لسعيها places striving in a direct relation to satisfaction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies purposeful earning and acceptance; I infer that satisfaction reconciles the agent to completed striving and settles the face. A live alternative is that satisfaction merely evaluates the work while the facial ease has an independent cause.

changed_reading.before: Ease appears passive and detached from exertion.
changed_reading.after: The face shows post-striving reconciliation: the whole person can inhabit prior effort without regret, strain, or unresolved demand.

context_deltas.mechanism: Physical elevation in the positive setting activates the social-rank branch of وجه, so the focus faces can be honored persons whose ease includes restored standing.

activation_trace.role: Eminence and rank let faces denote persons made socially prominent or honored.
Bounty makes the elevation beneficent rather than domineering.
Elevation as honor converts the garden's height into a possible status signal.
Raised degree reinforces dignity alongside the literal raising of places of repose.

structural_cues: The positive sequence places the faces in a high garden and then repeats elevation on the couches.
Concrete vertical arrangement follows immediately after satisfaction with striving.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies literal height together with branch images of honor and raised degree; I infer a spatial-to-social transfer onto the focus branch of eminent faces. The live alternative is that all elevation remains architectural and contributes only indirectly to comfort.

changed_reading.before: The faces are comfortable but socially unmarked.
changed_reading.after: They are countenances of restored dignity: persons visibly raised in standing as well as placed amid elevated surroundings.

context_deltas.mechanism: The positive environment is not an inventory of luxuries but a fitted habitat: enclosure, acoustic quiet, continuous provision, and objects already placed, aligned, and spread remove friction between person and place.

activation_trace.role: Face-for-self supplies the person whose condition is shaped by the surrounding habitat.
A place agreeing with and pleasing its inhabitant supplies the relational core of the model.
A garden enclosed by growth supplies protective habitation rather than bare exposure.
Mixed clamor, explicitly absent in the source clause, supplies acoustic friction removed from the habitat.
Continuous provision turns the running spring into sustained availability.
Placement in an appointed usable position makes the cups ready to meet need.
Even alignment supplies order and accessibility rather than random accumulation.
Spreading and distribution extend usable comfort across the setting.

structural_cues: Repeated فيها makes the setting a containing system around the focus persons.
The passive participles مرفوعة, موضوعة, مصفوفة, and مبثوثة present a world already arranged for use.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enclosure, silence, flow, placement, alignment, and distribution; I infer that these coordinated affordances produce the place-person agreement latent in ناعمة. Alternatively, the details may be independent signs of abundance rather than an ergonomic causal system.

changed_reading.before: Ease is an intrinsic property carried by the faces.
changed_reading.after: Ease is relational: their faces show how completely the surrounding place fits them, with provision flowing and the material world already arranged to answer embodied need.

context_deltas.mechanism: A latent eye, concealed joy, and disclosure sequence lets the face function as the place where inward ease comes outward: the countenance is eye-gladdened and broadcasts what had been interior.

activation_trace.role: The outward face provides the surface across which an inward state becomes visible.
The formula of an eye gladdened by blessing supplies a specifically ocular form of manifest joy.
The eye branch, latent in the spring word, reactivates the focus inventory's eye-gladdening image.
Hidden joy and ease supply the interior affect that the countenance can disclose.
Expressing what was concealed supplies the outward arrow from inward joy to visible face.

structural_cues: The focus begins with a visible body part, while the following setting moves through a spring, places of repose, and things spread outward.
The source forms at 88:12-16 support literal readings, so the eye-interior-disclosure chain remains a secondary activation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an eye branch, hidden joy, and disclosure; I infer a cross-branch inside-to-outside sequence ending on the face. The materially live alternative is the ordinary one: عين is only a spring, سرر only couches, and بث only spatial distribution.

changed_reading.before: The face simply possesses a pleasant external appearance.
changed_reading.after: The countenance is the broadcast surface of inward joy, especially an eye-gladdened ease that can no longer remain hidden.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated inspection of made and extended forms turns surfaces into evidence. Under that activation, the focus face is not just expressive but a formed, readable sign whose softness shows the condition impressed upon it.

activation_trace.role: The front that meets an observer supplies a human surface available for inspection.
Smooth softness supplies the perceivable quality carried by the formed surface.
Directed sight and reflection supply the act of treating visible form as evidence.
Completed and proportioned formation supplies a designed-form analogy for the focus countenance.
A smooth, even surface materially links created form to the softness branch of ناعمة.
The non-dominant mapped branch supplies a visible mark by which an observer reads condition.
An extended even surface reinforces surface itself as a bearer of legible arrangement.

structural_cues: The branchless cue ك ي ف repeats at 88:17, 88:18, 88:19, and 88:20 and is used only as a structural demand to inspect manner.
Passive خُلِقَتْ, رُفِعَتْ, نُصِبَتْ, and سُطِحَتْ organize the sequence around how visible forms were made.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies directed observation, formed and smooth surfaces, a split-mapping branch of visible condition-marking, and repeated manner questions; I infer an analogy from cosmic and animal surfaces back to the human face. Alternatively, the observational sequence may remain cosmological and may not invite rereading the earlier countenance.

changed_reading.before: Facial softness is a spontaneous expression to be noticed in passing.
changed_reading.after: The softened face is a constructed, inspectable sign: its surface makes an otherwise hidden condition readable, just as the later sequence asks visible forms to be read through how they were made.

context_deltas.mechanism: Reminder, face-turning, covering blessing, return, and reckoning create a trajectory of orientation. The focus faces can therefore be open, rightly directed countenances that carry acknowledged bounty rather than turning from and covering it.

activation_trace.role: Direction and destination make the focus face a trajectory as well as a body surface.
Blessing and good condition supply what can be received openly or concealed.
Recollection after forgetfulness supplies a possible reorientation toward what is true.
Turning the face and approaching provide the positive directional possibility latent inside the source root.
Turning away supplies the explicit contrary trajectory against which open facing is read.
Covering a blessing creates a direct negative counterpart to the bounty branch of ناعمة.
Return to a destination gives every orientation a terminal point.
Counting and account make the result of the trajectory answerable rather than accidental.

structural_cues: The closing sequence moves from reminding without control to an exception for one who turns away and covers, then to return and account.
The focus's face noun gives the later turn-away verb a bodily and directional echo.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies remembrance, opposed face-turning possibilities, concealment of blessing, return, and account; I infer that the positive face is open toward and visibly acknowledges bounty. Alternatively, the closing sequence may delimit only the negative addressee and need not characterize the earlier positive faces.

changed_reading.before: The faces enjoy bounty as passive recipients.
changed_reading.after: Their ease also signals orientation: they face rather than turn away, leave blessing uncovered, and arrive at return and account with an open countenance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The answer-yes branch of نعم becomes live when the closing address sets reminder against refusal and turning away. The focus face can then be response-bearing: an embodied yes shown face-to-face rather than merely spoken.

activation_trace.role: Face-to-face encounter supplies the relational scene in which a response is visibly borne.
Yes, confirmation, and promise supply an affirmative response latent beneath the adjective.
Reminder supplies the address to which affirmation or refusal can answer.
Turning away supplies the bodily contrary of remaining face-to-face in response.
Disavowal supplies the contrary speech-act to confirmation.

structural_cues: 88:21 is an imperative act of address, while 88:23 identifies a turn-away response.
The focus predicate's ordinary adjectival form keeps the affirmative layer latent rather than syntactically explicit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the focus root's yes-branch and a later address/refusal sequence; I infer that a face can embody its answer through continued facing. The strong alternative is that ناعمة is only adjectival here and the answer-word branch contributes no semantic layer.

changed_reading.before: ناعمة reports how the faces feel or look.
changed_reading.after: The countenances also carry an embodied yes: they remain present to the address, visibly confirming where the contrasting response turns away.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the livestock branch is form-distant from the focus adjective, but it remains anchored in the focus root and is independently reactivated by the explicit camel cue. Downstream prose should present it only as a pastoral abundance and provision echo, never as a claim that ناعمة literally means camel-like here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ناعمة at word 3 shares a root inventory with grazing livestock, especially camels, while the focus face remains the visible human anchor.

activation_trace.role: The livestock and camel branch supplies a latent pastoral register inside the focus adjective.
The explicit camel and its care reactivate the focus root's otherwise remote livestock register.
Directed observation makes the camel image available as a deliberate retrospective cue rather than incidental vocabulary.

changed_reading.before: The faces show private softness and luxury.
changed_reading.after: At the edge of the reading, their ease also carries a pastoral register of tended life, dependable provision, and abundance, later reawakened by the camel.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading depends on a non-dominant split mapping of the 88:9 striving root and is therefore branch-distant, but the packet explicitly preserves that branch and it connects visibly to the focus roots of orientation and place-fit. Downstream prose should call it a lexical counter-current, not replace the strong purposeful-striving reading with it.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: وجوه at word 1 can encode direction, and ناعمة at word 3 can encode arriving in a place that agrees with the person.

activation_trace.role: Direction and destination supply the route whose disorder or resolution can change the face's state.
A place fitting its inhabitant supplies the resolved destination.
The non-dominant branch of neglect or going off without orientation supplies a competing history of aimlessness.
Acceptance supplies the transition from unsettled movement to a destination one can inhabit willingly.

changed_reading.before: The faces are satisfied with purposeful effort.
changed_reading.after: A coexisting counter-current reads their ease as aimlessness finally resolved into a fitting orientation and inhabitable destination.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The soft-wind branch is materially evocative but morphologically remote from the focus adjective. It remains anchored through ناعمة and the face-as-front branch, while later flow and spreading provide a coherent ecological analogy. Downstream prose should qualify it as atmospheric imagery around ease, not a lexical gloss of the clause.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins an outward front at word 1 to a root at word 3 whose inventory includes a soft moist wind.

activation_trace.role: Face as outward front supplies a surface across which an atmosphere can be imagined as moving.
The soft moist south wind supplies dynamic gentleness rather than static texture.
Flow and free movement activate the wind branch's dynamic quality.
Spreading and diffusion give the gentle condition an environmental reach.

changed_reading.before: Softness is a fixed property of facial appearance.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, ease moves across these outward fronts like a soft moisture-bearing current and participates in the flowing, spread habitat.

strongest_changes: The exact 88:2/88:8 face-frame turns the focus countenance into a visible outcome surface rather than an isolated pleasant expression.
The failed work-and-nourishment sequence makes ناعمة relief from attritional need, while 88:9 makes that ease compatible with completed purposeful striving.
The positive setting activates place-person agreement: enclosure, quiet, flow, placement, alignment, and distribution jointly explain why the faces are at ease.
The closing turn-away, covering-of-blessing, return, and account sequence adds a directional reading in which the positive faces remain open toward acknowledged bounty.
summary.what_was_special: The focus supports several simultaneous scales: skin-softness, whole-person flourishing, approved orientation, elevated dignity, environmental fit, and an embodied affirmative response. The most unusual live activations came from the eye-gladdening branch, the sky cue's non-dominant visible-mark branch, the camel/livestock echo, and the non-dominant aimlessness branch; each changed the reading without displacing the stronger models.
remaining_uncertainties: The clause does not force a choice among literal face, person-by-face, social eminence, and directional facing.
The context strongly correlates effort, provision, setting, and facial state, but the exact causal arrows are reader-supplied.
The eye, affirmation, camel, soft-wind, and split-mapping activations should remain explicitly exploratory rather than become direct translations.
The observational creation sequence may invite retrospective reading of the face as a made sign, or it may remain a separate exhortation.
